meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把标题、数字或品牌徽标做成一气呵成的短视频动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里已有文案或数据,想快速做出无解说的短动画
copy.tagline_en: Turn titles, stats, or logos into a short animated motion clip
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have copy or data and want a quick narration-free animated clip

howto.what: 它按 hyperframes 流程,在 videos/<项目名>/ 下做一段以动效本身传意的短片(通常 10 秒内、无旁白),如动态文字、数字跳动、图表、logo 揭示、地图动画等,产出 MP4 或透明叠加层。
howto.when: 当你要一段以动效传意、无旁白、通常 10 秒以内的设计向短片(动态文字、数字跳动、图表等)时接管。更长、带旁白或多场景会转 /general-video,不确定先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我做一段 10 秒内的动态文字标题,不要旁白
做一个数字从 0 跳到 12,800 的动效
say.note: 用 stat 类(单个主数字+计数)

say.text: 把公司 logo 做成一段动效揭示

howto.what_en: It builds a short, design-led motion graphic under videos/<project>/ via the hyperframes flow — kinetic type, stat count-up, charts, logo reveals, map animation — usually under 10s, no narration, rendered to MP4 or a transparent overlay.
howto.when_en: Use for a short (usually under 10s), unnarrated, design-led motion graphic — kinetic type, stat count-up, charts, etc. Longer, narrated or multi-scene work goes to /general-video; unclear → /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make a 10-second kinetic-type title with no narration
Animate a number counting up to 12,800
Turn a company logo into an animated reveal
